retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century modern layout featuring a centered square abstract painting of a drum kit framed by a heavy black border with bold, high-contrast sans-serif typography at the top.
triggerTerms: bold red and yellow vintage typography
excludeWhen: clean minimalist digital art is requested
modern flat design is the goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition where an abstract, textured painting of a drum set is inset within a thick black frame. The painting uses aggressive palette knife strokes and a primary color palette. Above the image, two distinct blocks of bold, slanted typography sit on the black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured inset painting vs. flat black frame
Primary color palette (red, yellow, blue) against dark background
Slanted, heavy typography mirroring the energy of the abstract art
Geometric framing of chaotic, expressive subject matter
coreInvariants: Thick black border on all sides
Visible impasto texture in the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The abstract painting occupies the bottom 75% of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow and red circular forms representing drums and cymbals in the painting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold red text at the top left, move across to the yellow text, then drop into the chaotic energy of the central painting.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top provides a stage for the typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cadmium red and golden yellow (text and painting highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cerulean blue and burnt umber (painting details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors are placed against a zero-value black background for maximum punch.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, slanted sans-serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Lowercase-only or mixed-case with uniform height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy using the same typeface in two different primary colors.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular logo block in top right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and mid-century feel
Provides the necessary punch and era-appropriate look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured oil painting of a drum kit using a palette knife style with bold reds, yellows, and blues. Place this painting inside a square inset within a large solid black frame, leaving a wide black margin at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two phrases of text in the top black margin using a heavy, slanted sans-serif font. The first phrase should be bright red and the second should be golden yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the painting style abstract and textured?
Is the black frame thick and dominant?
Is the text slanted and extra-bold?
Are the colors limited to red, yellow, blue, and black?

avoid: Clean vector lines in the painting

postGenerationChecks: Check for impasto texture in the artwork
Ensure the black border is perfectly solid
Verify the text is lowercase and heavily slanted
Confirm the square aspect ratio of the inset art
recipe.reuseFormula: Abstract [Subject] Painting + Heavy Black Frame + Slanted Bold Sans-Serif Typography
